A1_one_case_in_one_triage_out_flow_is_cl.evidence: CLI and intake path accept one case per invocation and reject multi-case payloads.

A2_output_schema_is_valid_and_stable.evidence: Output schema is validated with explicit validation status and bounded repair metadata.

A3_recommendation_is_understandable_to_a.evidence: Reason summary, owner recommendation, and reviewer guidance are all expressed in business-readable language.

A4_system_remains_within_bounded_retry_r.evidence: Retry count remains bounded at zero and schema repair is limited to a single deterministic pass.

A5_no_unintended_downstream_automation.evidence: Guardrails explicitly block routing, approval, payment, and outbound communication actions.

A6_run_trace_and_audit_record_are_availa.evidence: Run metadata and bounded execution trace are emitted in every output payload.
